sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents in production environments, highlighting how memory management and tool integration are becoming critical bottlenecks. Shared insights on why most agent frameworks fail at scale and what architectural patterns are emerging as solutions.

sources.author: Swyx
sources.headline: Founder @ Latent.Space | AI Engineer
sources.post_summary: Analyzed the current state of AI infrastructure tooling, focusing on the gap between research prototypes and production-grade systems. Covered emerging patterns in model serving, evaluation frameworks, and the shift toward specialized AI engineering roles.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI Researcher | Creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Explored practical approaches to building reliable AI automation workflows using current tooling. Emphasized the importance of human-in-the-loop systems and shared specific techniques for reducing hallucination risks in automated processes.

sources.author: Kelvin Liew
sources.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Anthropic
sources.post_summary: Detailed the infrastructure challenges of running large-scale AI agents, including compute optimization strategies and cost management approaches. Shared lessons from deploying agent systems that handle thousands of concurrent tasks.

sources.author: Raza Habib
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ Humanloop
sources.post_summary: Discussed the evolution of developer tools for AI application development, focusing on evaluation frameworks and prompt management systems. Highlighted how teams are moving from ad-hoc development to systematic AI product engineering.

sources.author: Alex Hormozi
sources.headline: Founder @ Acquisition.com | Author of $100M Offers
sources.post_summary: Discussed how GTM engineering isn't just about outbound volume but structuring offers and systems that make sales predictable. Emphasized building repeatable processes over chasing leads.

sources.author: Elena Verna
sources.headline: Growth Advisor | Former CMO @ Amplitude, SurveyMonkey
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on modern GTM engineering, highlighting how product-led growth combined with targeted outbound automation creates efficient revenue funnels without bloated sales teams.

sources.author: Harry Stebbings
sources.headline: Founder @ 20VC | Investor
sources.post_summary: Talked about how top SaaS companies are rethinking sales ops and revenue operations by embedding data-driven decision making into every stage of the customer journey.

sources.author: April Dunford
sources.headline: Positioning Expert | Author of Obviously Awesome
sources.post_summary: Explored the intersection of content strategy and GTM, arguing that strong positioning must precede any outbound automation efforts to avoid wasting resources on misaligned audiences.

sources.author: Kyle Poyar
sources.headline: Operating Partner @ OpenView | SaaS Metrics Expert
sources.post_summary: Broke down how modern revenue operations teams are using automation not just for outreach but for pipeline hygiene, forecasting accuracy, and reducing CAC through smarter segmentation.

sources.author: Arvid Kahl
sources.headline: Indie Maker | Author of Zero to Sold | Bootstrapped Founder
sources.post_summary: Shared his journey of building and launching a new micro-SaaS product solo over 30 days, detailing weekly revenue milestones, customer acquisition via Twitter and LinkedIn, and lessons on pricing experiments.

sources.author: Danny Postma
sources.headline: Founder @ Headlime & 10+ AI tools | Solo builder
sources.post_summary: Posted about pivoting from a failed consumer app to a profitable AI writing tool, explaining the exact feature changes and marketing channels that led to $8k MRR within 4 months of the pivot.

sources.author: Vic Vijayakumar
sources.headline: Ex-Google | Solo founder building in public
sources.post_summary: Documented shipping a new open-source CLI tool for developers, including the technical decisions, GitHub traction numbers, and how consistent weekly updates helped grow an engaged community from scratch.

sources.author: Sara Mauskopf
sources.headline: Founder & CEO @ Winnie | ex-Google, Twitter
sources.post_summary: Wrote about transitioning from big tech to solo founder life, sharing the emotional and practical challenges of the first 90 days, including how she validated her new product idea with 50 customer interviews.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Founder @ Nomad List, Remote OK | Indie Maker
sources.post_summary: Shared real-time updates on launching a new micro-product in a weekend, including live revenue screenshots, tech stack choices, and how he uses simple landing pages to validate ideas quickly.
